latest_release.name: Measurement Tools and A Year of BentoPDF! - v2.8.11
latest_release.body:
## Dad Joke Of the Release
Why don't skeletons fight each other? Because they don't have the guts 🤣

## BentoPDF Is One Year Old! 🎉

I didn't realize this. The [first release of BentoPDF, v1.0.0](https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/releases/tag/v1.0.0), went out on **20 October 2025**, which means BentoPDF is now **one year old**! I'm so thankful to every one of you who used it, shared it, reported bugs, translated it and sent PRs. None of this would have happened without you. ❤️

### Also I need your support to keep going

BentoPDF has grown into a lot more than one tool, but behind it there is still **just one core maintainer: me**. Every feature, every engine, every bug fix, every PR review and every issue reply goes through one person, and keeping this pace up on my own is getting really hard.

**Your support goes directly into:**

* **BentoPDF**, with faster releases and faster fixes
* **[Kura](https://www.bentopdf.com/kura)**, our PDF standards and preflight engine
* **[Hyper Compress](https://www.bentopdf.com/hyper-compress)**, our compression engine
* **BentoParse**, our new document parsing engine
* **Hiring a second core maintainer** to work full time on BentoPDF, so the project no longer depends on just one person

**Here's how you can help:**

1. **Sponsor on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/alam00000).** Monthly sponsorships make the biggest difference, even small ones, because they let me plan ahead. You can also chip in once on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/alio01).
2. **Advertise on bentopdf.com.** The homepage now has a sponsor section right above the tools. The last time we had analytics, bentopdf.com was getting around **20,000 views a day**, and it's very likely more now (we removed Simple Analytics, so we can't say for sure). Ads are plain logos and links: no tracking, no scripts and no pop-ups, and **self-hosted copies never show them**. Book a slot at [bentopdf.com/advertise](https://www.bentopdf.com/advertise).
3. **Get a commercial license** if your company uses BentoPDF and doesn't want the AGPL obligations. See [bentopdf.com/licensing](https://www.bentopdf.com/licensing).

Every sponsor, every ad and every license helps keep BentoPDF free and private for everyone. Even if you can't, thank you for using it! ❤️

Alright, so back on to the release.

## 1. Measurement Tools

BentoPDF can now measure directly on your PDFs. Open any PDF in the PDF Editor, switch to **Measure** tab.

* **Distance, Perimeter and Area** tools for floor plans, drawings, maps and anything else drawn to scale
* **Set the scale** by typing it in, or **calibrate** it by clicking two points of a length you already know
* **Scale areas**: give different parts of a page their own scale, for drawings that have several views or details on one sheet. Scales already saved inside a PDF are picked up automatically
* **Snapping** to the drawing itself: endpoints, midpoints, intersections and along lines. Shapes snap together cleanly, so a new area can start exactly on the corner of another one
* **Magnifier**: a loupe follows your cursor and zooms in on the spot you're measuring, so you can place points precisely on small details. You can turn it off from the Measure toolbar
* **Units**: in, ft, yd, mi, mm, cm, m, km and pt, with decimal or fractional precision (1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16)
* **Saved as standard PDF measurement data**, so your measurements stay with the file

## 2. Favorite Tools

Star the tools you use most and they get pinned to a **Favorites** section at the top of the homepage. On mobiles, hold the tool card to favorite.

## 3. PDF Multi Tool Revamp

The PDF multi tool has been redesigned for a cleaner interface, and can now handle very large PDFs, upto 10k pages even, with ease. 

- Insert pages from a file, a blank page, pages from the clipboard, or Alternate Merge to interleave another PDF's pages before or after each page
- Cut, copy, paste, duplicate and replace
